observations.result: State, contracts, architecture, distribution metadata, strict typecheck, 61 tests with 282 expectations, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health is 89.0/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow moderate advisory and documented distribution warnings.
No issues in the 4 changed files for this command-palette and workspace-journey increment.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
61 tests with 282 expectations pass, including the workspace journey fixture and static keyboard-entry-point contract.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile; the renderer includes the command palette, keyboard shortcuts and safe command dispatch.

implemented: Added a keyboard-first command palette with searchable available commands, explicit shortcuts, visible entry-point actions and safe DOM text rendering.
Added Meta/Ctrl-K command-palette handling alongside the existing quick-switcher and save-note shortcuts, with keyboard focus movement from the query to the first result.
Added a versioned workspace-journey fixture and contract test covering existing-vault adoption, search/edit/save, change recovery and derived Graph/Canvas/Bases entry points.
limitations: The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so visible launch, keyboard-only execution, screen-reader tree inspection and cross-platform UI automation were not completed.

The fixture and renderer contract cover command availability and entry points, but C10 end-to-end keyboard execution, IME/RTL behavior, pop-out behavior and reference Obsidian reopen checks remain pending.
Richer Markdown dialect rendering and the remaining named UX inventory surfaces remain pending.
